explanation: Faithfully encodes the first assertion on erdosproblems.com/1177: if some 3-uniform hypergraph with chromatic number ℵ₁ omits the finite G (as a not necessarily induced subhypergraph, via Appears), then one exists on at most 2^{2^{ℵ₀}} vertices. The status rests on Li [Li26, Cor. 1.4(1)], which I did not independently check; the page lists the problem without a resolution. The formal statement itself is correct.
